FAQ

Good to know

Do you charge a call-out fee?

No — never. You only pay for work you approve, at the fixed price we quote.

How fast can you reach me in an emergency?

Across Greater Manchester we aim for 60–90 minutes, 24 hours a day.

Are you Gas Safe registered?

Yes. All gas and boiler work is carried out and certified by Gas Safe registered engineers.

Is your work guaranteed?

Every job carries a 12-month workmanship guarantee in writing, plus boiler warranties of up to 10 years.
